purpose: SON/SEGMENT -> mots -> images/conventions/compositions -> qualite phonétique -> état visuel

categoryDefinitions.C_exactWordVisualNotReady: C — mot exact mais aucune image prête/évidente
categoryDefinitions.F_exactMultiPictogram: F — composition exacte de plusieurs pictogrammes
categoryDefinitions.I_noCurrentReasonableRepresentation: I — aucune représentation raisonnable actuellement disponible

methodology.usefulScope: Rows with usefulTargetCount > 0 are the product-priority denominator; the exhaustive 1–2 syllable catalog remains canonical and untouched.
methodology.exactWords: Lexique whole-pronunciation candidates are evidence of lexical existence, not visual approval.
methodology.visual: A ready image is distinct from an exact lexical lead. visualConfidence/labelStability are design metadata, not observed naming evidence. Curated prototypes remain research until naming evidence exists.
methodology.naming: Human naming evidence comes only from explicit naming-review records. Missing or not-run reviews are never inferred as successful from design scores.
methodology.combinations: F routes concatenate 2–3 exact ready-image pronunciations with no deletion or substitution.
methodology.approximations: E only reports candidates already classified light by the existing approximation engine; strict eligibility is never inferred.
methodology.unresolved: I means no current ready image, exact ready-image composition, visible letter/number/note, curated prototype, or light approximation using an existing asset. An unreviewed Lexique word alone does not count as a reasonable representation.

productionVisualBoundary.explanation: Production loads lexicon-seed first, then merges OpenMoji waves while skipping duplicate ids/labels. Therefore a seed entry intentionally keeps its local asset even when an OpenMoji pictogram with the same concept exists.
